run_scope: H16 2-head one-layer INT8 persistent incremental KV Append; four-token prefill followed by host-fed decode steps in one Top session
model_scope: trained decoder-only causal next-token model on a synthetic finite-state token language; not natural-text pretraining

training.algorithm: AdamW cross-entropy, deterministic CPU, full causal next-token objective
training.corpus: seeded finite-state synthetic token sequences; token IDs 0..3 encode transition mode and 4..31 encode symbol state
training.quantized_quality: computed by reference_tiny_gpt2_int8.py; not inherited from float metrics

host_fallback: model training and independent quantized software reference
token/position embedding lookup and greedy argmax are host responsibilities
Top descriptor batches accept host-supplied input IDs; closed-loop replay feeds observed Top logits back between runs

cache_contract.window_policy: 8-entry ring; after capacity, overwrite the oldest slot; position embedding wraps modulo 8 and all eight live slots are visible
cache_contract.append_mechanism: K uses legacy word-strided KV_WRITE; V uses opt-in ABI-v7 0x43 flags[0] byte-lane read/modify/write scatter
cache_contract.readback: full 16-word 8x8 Matrix-B tile after each append

events: one-bit ordered completion chain per batch
model_quality: seeded finite-state synthetic token sequences; token IDs 0..3 encode transition mode and 4..31 encode symbol state
